description: Apply config/sync entries to the database with the plugin's own import (a role, a content-manager view, a setting). `keys` is required, never everything; an entry only in the database is deleted from it; an `invalid-file` is never imported. The entries still different afterwards are exported back (`reexport`), so the diff converges. Refused with NODE_ENV=production. It loads the project's Strapi the way config-sync's CLI does, which writes to the database as a `strapi develop` start does (schema sync, migrations): a local development database only — a remote one, or a Strapi 4 database under Strapi 5 code, is refused first.

from.description: A path inside the project (the file you are editing; relative to its root with `project`), in a multi-project workspace.

project.description: A project name or root, when no path is at hand.

reexport.description: Export back the entries still different afterwards (default true).

name: config_sync_import
title: config-sync: import entries from config/sync into the database
